main_text.head: Primus Francorum Rex fuit Marcomerus.
main_text.p: Primus Francorum Rex in GermaniaElectus[?] A. C. 418. Ei postan-num successit Faramundus, a quo vulgo series Regum Franciae deducitur. Huic successit Clodio Comatus. Et hi in Germania regnarunt. Primus autem in Gallia inde (.\Me- rovingo rum familia.Merovingus Galliam occupavit, quae in posterum Francia dicta fuit. Ab hoc Merovingo primo Regum Franciae familia vocatur Merovingorum, sub quibus regnum Franciae aliquoties divisum fuit in haec quatuor regna: 1. in regnum Franciae sive Parisiorum. 2. in regnum Belgicae, cujus sedes urbs Suessionum. 3. in regnum Aurelianorum, cujus sedes Aurelianum. 4. in regnum Austrasiae, cujus sedes urbs Mediomatricum sive Metz.
main_text.head: Periodus II.

page.notes: The margin note "(.\Me-" is unclear; it is transcribed as printed with a [?] reading not applied. "Electus" at the start of the paragraph has an ft/ct ligature that is hard to read; the reading "Electus" is marked [?]. The catchword "Me-" at the lower right is treated as a catchword and also appears in the body as the final line; this may be a duplication to check. Italic words: Faramundus, Clodio Comatus, Merovingus, Francia, Merovingorum, Franciae, Belgicae, Austrasiae, Marcomerus are set in italic or swash type in the print and are not all marked with <i> above.
